subject.title: feat: fire session reset hooks for daily and idle resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollovers invoke the existing plugin-visible `before_reset` hook and expose `command:daily`/`command:idle` actions, or should bundled session-memory receive a narrower dedicated lifecycle seam?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested behavior, while the open canonical issue frames the hook shape as a product/API decision; the PR changes observable hook semantics rather than only repairing an internal implementation detail.

options.title: Approve automatic reset hook delivery
options.body: Adopt daily/idle delivery through the existing hook contract, then require a current-main rebase, compatibility coverage, and runtime proof.

options.title: Use a narrower memory-only seam
options.body: Keep generic plugin hook semantics unchanged and design a dedicated lifecycle event or bundled-session-memory path instead.

recommendation.title: Approve automatic reset hook delivery
recommendation.body: Adopt daily/idle delivery through the existing hook contract, then require a current-main rebase, compatibility coverage, and runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They repaired this branch and are the strongest supplied hooks/plugins routing contact; current-main session owners should participate in the rebase review.
